notes.title: Soundtrack Now Available + Game Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33367165/fab06a9267f1649528b1abe501895b5e2770f065.jpg

Many of our fans were asking for it, and it's finally here! The Official Soundtrack features 37 moody and atmospheric tracks. And, best of all, we're donating the proceeds to the Washington Epilepsy Foundation, as per request of the composer who is struggling with the illness.

notes.title: Update: Controller support, re-balances, performance & bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Award-winning "Papers, Please meets Oxenfree" adventure where you play as a news editor & shape public opinion. Set in a genetically-modified society plagued by mysterious disease and foreign threat... 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367165/4de7f40806cbeb50bfdc787c792027d2a695cd4b.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367165/cb88c8cf6d26ede92bed2bb780f45cbd756f3a92.png

The new version of Headliner: NoviNews is official! 

Highlights:

 Controller and Keyboard support (with an alternate Office functionality mode)
 Office articles will now "stick" when dragged to the top (you no longer have to hold the mouse)
 You can now stamp Staff Memos and Letters (yes, this was requested a lot, lol)
 Re-balances and re-writes, making the game bit more forgiving and with a wider "middle-ground" path 
 Improved performance and fixed ton of bugs/typos!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367165/95dbc1c9d5d1cea3c8bbcbff974305c85a71806c.gif


Full Changelog below: 

1.2.2
[WRIT] Justin no longer asks you how your date went (Bro04_Crashover0) if you didn't get the date with Evie 
[WRIT] Radio no longer mentions truck accident if it didn't happen
[TWEAK] Removed Doggo AI log spam at home

        
--------------------------------------------------
1.2.1
[BUG] Fixed a bug that could freeze convos if 2 convos were played right after another (accidentally re-introduced the "doggo freeze bug")

--------------------------------------------------

[BUG] Fixed dying cops/rioters occasionally freezing in place instead of playing dying animation
[TYPO] Fixed typo in Evie convo in Day 12 ("They’ve taken taken the boss away")
[TYPO] Fixed home Dronno conversation typo ("... prohibits me from pursing punitive actions..." should be "pursuing")
[TYPO] Fixed several article typos and overflow issues
[TWEAK] Removed Main Menu "Quit" button on Nintendo Switch
[TWEAK] In conversation, if you click/tap away from the dialogue, pressing up/down will now re-select the first option
[TWEAK] Adjusted amount of Police/Drones/Drunks/Crazies who spawn randomly
[TWEAK] PlayerCreate and Doggo Namer will not let you select the InputFields if using controller (otherwise get stuck) and include a note saying to use mouse/keyboard to select those fields

notes.title: Play next big update early on beta branch!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367165/67bb73480ed18513dad61e04f6335d91929f641d.jpg

Hey everyone,

We've been listening to feedback and working on a patch with some big re-balances and re-writes (on top of usual bug fixes). We'd like to share early access to the new version before it goes official, and in turn ask you let us know if you run into any bugs or glitches :)

What's New?
The biggest complaint was that the game is a little too punishing and some events weren't clearly connected to your actions. We re-balanced a number of events, added some extra rewards and articles, and re-wrote some dialogues to make things clearer. There's also now a wider "middle ground" path you can take with less crazy things happening. But don't worry, you can still turn the city into a burning mess, you just have to try a bit harder now ;)

On top of that, we're also adding a full keyboard/controller mode support! We're still tweaking it, but the new keys are:


 [Arrows] / Joystick - move around and switch between articles
 [Space] / Joy 1 - Interact / Approve current paper  
 [Tab] / Joy 2 - Cancel / Reject current paper
 [E] / Joy 3 - Exit the Office
 [Escape] / Joy 4 - Pause/Quit menu


We will post the full change log when the patch is officially out, but there's quite a lot of tweaks. 

How to access the update?
In your Steam library, right click on Headliner: NoviNews and select Properites. Go to the Betas tab and in the box, put the code "fakenewsfake" (without quotations). Click "Check Code," and it should show a confirmation message below. Now, select "beta" from the dropdown and click close. The game should now update and show [beta] next to it in your Steam library. If it doesn't, try restarting Steam. In the main menu, you should see version 1.1.5 on the bottom right, to confirm.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367165/96c487b1475bd2b79a432f715977227960fe2aa5.jpg

Share your feedback!
As always, we're greatful for any feedback we get! Particularly if you run into any bugs and glitches. Just post in our forums or join our discord, or comment on this announcement!

Cheers,
Jakub
Lead Dev

notes.title: Big Content Update and Price Change Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The past month and a half we've been working on a big, big update! We're expanding the existing cop lady into a whole new character you can chat with daily, together with her own murder-mystery side-plot! *GASP* 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367165/6d02dd94e7647857e9e0bad12a04c3f37f0e1c0f.gif

We've also been listening to your feedback and added a whole bunch of Quality of Life improvements, like a toggle for the Speech Bubble speed, higher resolution graffiti text, improved NPC behavior, and bunch of other bugfixes and tweaks. 

Finally, we'll also release the Mac version and hopefully Linux (if we can sort some linux-specific bugs in time). 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367165/397205b75f9ac0ddc41022d7fdee6899a128f713.jpg


We're planning to release the update in the next week or two. We are also raising the price into the $10-15 range (TBD). After talking with fellow devs and our community (AKA you!), we feel it better reflects the value of the game, especially with the new content and fixes. 

However, if you already bought the game, or buy before the update, all the new content is totally free for you :) So here's a heads up to grab it in the next few days, if you want to save some $$
